note: Submodule of workflow_buttons. Installs one content_moderation workflow, workflows.workflow.workflow_buttons_trash_publishing ('Publishing (with draft and soft delete)'), with states draft/published/trash/unpublished and a 'delete' transition that moves content to the trash state (soft delete), plus restore_draft and restore_publish transitions; default_moderation_state draft. Also registers a 'Trash' local task at /admin/content/trash (route has title+permission only, no controller in this release). No settings form, config schema, permissions, or Drush. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the shipped workflow config (reliably writable): introspection reads the trash state / delete-transition labels; execution restores the deleted workflow and fixes its default moderation state, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: What does the workflow_buttons_trash (Trash workflow) module provide, and what happens when content is deleted under it?
evals.expected_output: It installs a content_moderation workflow (workflow_buttons_trash_publishing) with a soft-delete 'Trash' state: the 'delete' transition moves content to the trash state instead of removing it, and restore_draft / restore_publish transitions bring it back.

evals.prompt: Which workflow does workflow_buttons_trash install and what states does it have?
evals.expected_output: It installs workflows.workflow.workflow_buttons_trash_publishing ('Publishing (with draft and soft delete)') with states draft, published, trash, and unpublished; default_moderation_state is draft.

evals.prompt: Under the Trash workflow (workflow_buttons_trash), how does an editor get content back out of Trash, and is there a Trash listing?
evals.expected_output: The restore_draft (trash -> draft) and restore_publish (trash -> published) transitions bring content back. The submodule also registers a 'Trash' local task at /admin/content/trash (title/permission only in this release).

evals.prompt: On this site the Trash workflow has been customised. Inspect the live workflow_buttons_trash_publishing workflow config and state the label of its soft-delete (trash) state.
evals.expected_output: In workflows.workflow.workflow_buttons_trash_publishing the trash state's label is 'Recycle Bin Eval' (type_settings.states.trash.label).

evals.prompt: Inspect the live Trash workflow config on this site and state the label of the transition that moves content into the Trash state.
evals.expected_output: The 'delete' transition (from draft/published/unpublished to trash) has label 'Move to Bin Eval' (type_settings.transitions.delete.label).

evals.prompt: The Trash workflow (workflows.workflow.workflow_buttons_trash_publishing) has been deleted from this site. Restore it so it again has a 'trash' state and a delete transition that moves content to trash. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: workflows.workflow.workflow_buttons_trash_publishing exists again with a trash state and a 'delete' transition whose 'to' is trash -- e.g. re-import the submodule's config/install/workflows.workflow.workflow_buttons_trash_publishing.yml (drush config:import --partial, or set the config data from the file).

evals.prompt: Someone changed the Trash workflow's default moderation state to Published. Restore the workflow_buttons_trash_publishing workflow so new content starts in the Draft state. Apply the change to the live site.
